#373 is an English Rogan podcast clip about Demetrious Johnson; #380 is a Spanish-sourced clip (@MayteClaraX) 'the greatest thing I've learned is to listen to my mother' about his divorce - different occasion and topic

#728's headline quotes ('defeat did not extinguish the fire', 'I cannot promise any result') are the essay's lines, with the Hugo post mentioned only as his return to social media; #675 is the Hugo video itself ('Hugo, I've been thinking about you... We are back!!!')
